name: Haste
components: V, S, M (shaving of licorice root)
summary: Double speed, +2 AC, advantage on DEX saves, extra action (limited).
description: Willing creature: speed doubled, +2 AC, DEX save advantage, one extra action (Attack one weapon attack only / Dash / Disengage / Hide). After spell: can't move or act for 1 turn (lethargy).
